title: FactorMAD: Multi-Agent Debate for Factor Signal Refinement
source: arXiv:2605.19337 — 'Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets' (FactorMAD module)
rationale: FactorMAD uses multi-agent debate where multiple LLM agents critique and refine proposed quantitative factors before backtesting. The approach automates strategy discovery: (1) propose factor, (2) agents debate logic/look-ahead/robustness, (3) refined factor code generated, (4) backtest run. Reported 53.17% cumulative returns on SSE50 universe. For our pipeline, this could accelerate the dream cycle scan Phase 2 — rather than George manually proposing hypotheses, FactorMAD could run in a sandbox and generate + validate proposals more rapidly. Low-risk implementation: use as research accelerator tool, not production signal.

design.approach: Spawn a collaborator agent with FactorMAD-style instructions: propose 5 factor ideas, have a critic agent evaluate each for look-ahead bias and overfitting risk, accept only factors passing both agents

agents.task: Generate factor from academic paper or novel combination
Identify look-ahead bias, data mining, and overfitting risks
Accept/reject based on debate; produce final implementation spec

design.output: Validated factor spec JSON suitable for hypothesis-log staging
design.integration: Run as nightly dream cycle Phase 2 enhancement — 3 FactorMAD proposals per night alongside George's manual scan

confirm_gates.process_gate: Multi-agent debate catches at least 1 methodology error per 5 proposals (track in research log)
confirm_gates.outcome_gate: FactorMAD-originated hypotheses confirm at >= 25% rate (vs current ~20% overall confirmation rate)

notes: No backtest file needed — this is a research process enhancement, not a trading hypothesis. Implement by adding FactorMAD-style instructions to the nightly dream cycle scan prompt.

hypothesis_log_entry.note: Process improvement proposal: use multi-agent debate to validate factor proposals before backtesting. Paper reports 53.17% cumulative returns (SSE50, unknown OOS discipline). Primary value is as a look-ahead bias detection layer in the dream cycle, not as a standalone trading signal.
